evidence: The approved schema contract declares commerce.returns as one row per return_id, so COUNT(*) is equivalent to COUNT(DISTINCT return_id) at this table grain. The SQL filters return_date to calendar 2025 and groups by month. Output alias and timestamp/date representation are assessed separately by output/result scoring.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The query first sums net order-item value at order_id and month grain, filters order_status=delivered and calendar year 2025, then averages delivered order totals by month. This matches the requested average delivered order value.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The query counts customers joined by ZIP to geography, filtered to Hai Phong, age_group 25-34, and signup_date in 2024. The approved schema contract declares one customer per customer_id and one geography row per ZIP, so COUNT(*) preserves distinct-customer count.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The query sums revenue and COGS from sales rows in 2024 where the row-level condition cogs > revenue holds. Aggregates and scope match the request.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The query sums refund_amount by non-NULL return_reason for calendar year 2024. The alternative output alias does not change the selected metric, population, grouping, or time scope.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The query counts rows in commerce.orders, whose approved schema grain is one row per order_id, filtered to calendar year 2025, paid_search and mobile. The row count therefore matches the requested order count.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The SQL selects product_id and catalog p.cogs, orders by p.cogs DESC then product_id ASC, and limits to 5. It is semantically aligned with the requested top five catalog COGS ranking; execution was blocked by a ranking-validator rejection, which is reported separately.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The request and frozen Gold use the snapshot-stored inventory.segment. The observed SQL groups by commerce.products.segment, a current catalog attribute with no historical validity, so it can assign historical snapshot quantities to the wrong segment.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The request and frozen Gold define delivered orders by orders.order_status and scope the year using orders.order_date. The observed SQL instead filters shipments.delivery_date and does not constrain orders.order_status or order_date; it changes both population and time semantics.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The query sums return_quantity by the destination city reached through returns.order_id -> orders.zip -> geography.zip and filters by return_date in 2025. Ordering is not semantic for this unordered case.

evidence: The query sums return_quantity by product_id over [2023-01-01, 2026-01-01), which includes calendar years 2023 through 2025 and excludes 2026.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The query averages all review ratings grouped by the current products.category using the approved product_id join. This matches the explicit current-category and all-history request.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The query sums recorded payment_value by payment_method for payment rows whose linked order_date is in calendar 2025. This preserves the requested recorded-payment metric and date basis.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The query calculates AVG(shipping_fee) and COUNT(shipping_fee) by destination city for shipments with ship_date in 2025. Joining orders to geography uses the approved destination ZIP path; COUNT excludes NULL fees as requested.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The request is snapshot-scoped and the approved historical dimension is inventory.category. The observed SQL groups by current products.category, which can disagree with the category recorded on the snapshot row.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The approved inventory grain is one row per (snapshot_date, product_id). The query groups by snapshot_date, counts distinct products with non-NULL days_of_supply and separately counts products whose days_of_supply is NULL, preserving NULL rather than coercing it to zero across the inclusive snapshot range.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The request requires matching products across exactly two snapshots and computing before, after, and after-minus-before. The observed SQL returns individual snapshot_date/product_id/stock_on_hand rows and does not pivot, require presence in both dates, or calculate the delta.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The query sums stock_on_hand separately for each snapshot_date within [2025-09-30, 2025-12-01), so it does not sum balances across dates. The products join is many-to-one under the approved product_id key and does not alter inventory grain.

records.auditor_version: 2026-11-22; review based on frozen case contracts and data/semantic/commerce_schema_metric_contract_v1.md
evidence: The request explicitly asks for category stored in each inventory row. The observed SQL groups by current products.category, which can disagree with historical inventory.category; it also returns unrequested total/non-null/null count outputs.
